body: The raptor paddock gate was standing open when we walked past at about 3pm. No staff anywhere. My kids are six and eight. Please tell me someone knows about this.
Quick question, can we bring our own snacks into the park? Planning a trip next month with a toddler.
This is the third time you have charged my card for season passes we canceled in January. I have emailed twice. Nobody answers. I want a person to look at this now.
Our Swamp Safari jeep stalled halfway through the tour this afternoon and we sat there for forty minutes next to the spinosaurus pond. The driver said it happens a lot.
The monorail doors opened on the wrong side at the canopy station, the side with no platform. Nobody fell but it was close. This was on the 11:15 run.
It would be great if the park had a quiet room. My son is autistic and the T. rex roar every fifteen minutes was a lot for him. Otherwise a lovely day.
I left my daughter's stuffed stegosaurus on the monorail yesterday around noon. It is green, one eye missing, answers to Zeus. She has not slept.
The churros at the Dino Diner are shaped like little femurs and my kids think it is the funniest thing ever. Just wanted to say thanks.
The T. rex lay down in the middle of the 2pm feeding show and has not moved since. Half the crowd is crying. Is it sick? Is it okay?
How do I get the monorail to stop at the hatchery? It skipped it twice today.
We bought the Fast Fossil pass but the Swamp Safari line told us it does not count there. Your website says it counts for every ride.
Can someone explain my receipt? There are eleven lines and I only bought two tickets and a hot dog.
A pteranodon took my sandwich right out of my hand on the Dino Diner patio about an hour ago and scratched my wrist doing it. It is bleeding a bit. Where is first aid?
My son and I got separated near the swamp safari exit. He is ten and wearing a red raptor hoodie. PLEASE HELP.
The veggie burger at the Dino Diner tasted like it had been cooked next to the beef. I am vegetarian. Does it share a grill?
We need a receipt with our company's tax number on it for the team outing on the 14th. The ticket office says it has already been issued and cannot be changed.
the ride broke
Is the Raptor Paddock night walk still running this season? The website still shows last year's dates.
The monorail stopped between stations at about 6pm with the power off and we were stuck above the brachiosaurus field for an hour in the heat. An older man in our car fainted.
Please cancel our season passes at the end of this year. We loved it, the kids have just outgrown dinosaurs. Do we get anything back for the months left?
Third time this week the turnstile has rejected my season pass with code GATE-4102 and I have to queue at the office. I pay for this pass. Fix it.
I lost my car keys somewhere between the monorail and the Dino Diner. Black fob with a little plastic triceratops on it. Has anyone turned them in?
Our card was replaced after a fraud alert and the new one is on file, but the app still says our annual pass is suspended. Do I wait or do something?
The viewing glass at T. rex Kingdom has a crack running across it, bottom left corner, near the bench. Probably fine but figured you would want to know.
One of your staff let my group past the rope during the 10am hatchery tour and let the kids touch an egg. Great for us, but surely that is not allowed?
The Swamp Safari photo booth took our picture but it never showed up in the app. The screen said PHOTO-2231.
Could you add more shade to the T. rex Kingdom queue? We waited forty minutes in full sun with nowhere to stand out of it.
I got food poisoning after eating the nachos at the Dino Diner on Saturday. Three of us were sick that night.
What time does the park close on weekdays in October? Planning a visit for our class.
Someone has been buying tickets with my card. There are six charges from your park this morning that I did not make. I have canceled the card. What else should I do?
The park app went down at opening and nobody's tickets will scan. The queue goes out to the parking lot and it is 95 degrees. Do something now.
The new velociraptor show is fantastic, and the keeper who narrates it is hilarious. No issue, just wanted to say so.
The raptors have learned to open their feeding hatch. I watched one do it three times this morning while the keeper was on the other side of the paddock. Is that on purpose?
We need to change the name on our group booking. The teacher who booked it left our school in December and we cannot get into the booking at all.
Monorail is slow. Has been all summer. Not sure what else to tell you.
Our school needs proof that the Swamp Safari jeeps have seat belts for the permission slips. Can someone send that in writing?
My friend is visiting from out of state and the app will not accept her card for a guest pass. Is that deliberate or has something gone wrong?
Your website says our booking expires tomorrow and the refund button does nothing. We canceled the trip because my son broke his leg. After tomorrow I understand we lose everything.
The splash pad next to the Dino Diner smells like a swamp and the water looks cloudy. Kids are still playing in it.
Following up on my message from eight days ago about being charged twice. Still nothing. I have now been charged twice again this month. Cancel the pass if nobody is going to answer.
